ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First read from the stem: the solution set of the inequality ax-b<0 is (1,+∞). Analyzing the linear inequality ax-b<0, its critical point satisfies ax-b=0, that is, x=b/a. If a>0, then the solution set should be on the left side of the critical point; if a<0, then the solution set is on the right side of the critical point. Now the solution set is (1,+∞), so a<0, and the critical point b/a=1, therefore b=a. Substitute b=a into the target inequality (ax+b)(x-3)>0, obtaining (ax+a)(x-3)>0, that is, a(x+1)(x-3)>0. Because a<0, when dividing both sides by a the inequality sign reverses, becoming (x+1)(x-3)<0. The two zeros are x=-1 and x=3, and the interval where the product is less than 0 is between the two roots, so the solution set is (-1,3).

method.method_draft: 先从题干读出：不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)。对一次不等式分析，分界点为 x=b/a，且解集在分界点右侧，说明 a<0 且 b/a=1，所以 b=a。将 b=a 代入目标不等式，得 (ax+b)(x-3)=a(x+1)(x-3)>0。因为 a<0，除以 a 时不等号反向，化为 (x+1)(x-3)<0。两个零点为 -1 和 3，二次乘积小于 0 的区间在两根之间，所以解集为 (-1,3)。

method.method_draft: 利用等价代表取值法。由 ax-b<0 的解集是 x>1，可知对应一次函数必须在 x=1 处为 0，且右侧取负，因此可取一组满足条件的代表参数，例如 a=-1，b=-1，因为 -x+1<0 的解集正是 x>1。代入要求的不等式，得到 (-x-1)(x-3)>0，即 -(x+1)(x-3)>0，等价于 (x+1)(x-3)<0。两因式异号时成立，故 -1<x<3，解集为 (-1,3)。
